_comment: raised = total raised so far, in whole dollars. tiers: each one is a funding goal. pts = game points shown on the tower. need = what that item costs. priority = what the money fills first (1 is funded before 2, before 3...), independent of where it sits on the tower. label + note describe it.

tiers.label: Tournament day kit
tiers.note: A pit banner, a toolbox, a table cover, and team shirts. What it takes to show up looking like a team.

tiers.label: Spare parts and batteries
tiers.note: Gears snap, axles bend, batteries age. A shelf of spares is what keeps a practice from ending early.

tiers.label: Shop materials
tiers.note: Filament for the printers, acrylic and wood for the laser. This is also what we make our products out of.

tiers.label: A practice field we build ourselves
tiers.note: The official field is only sold to teams registered with VEX (not RECF), so we're building our own. Foam tiles and lumber for the field, bean bags to score with, and we print the goals ourselves on the shop printers.

tiers.label: A second robot and its team
tiers.note: A kit is $844 delivered and registering the team to compete is another $175. One kit builds one robot, and one robot is one team. Two smaller teams would let every student contribute in their own way — their creativity, their dedication, their ideas — instead of taking turns on a single robot.
